svg.aria-label: Six featured projects by Gohar Abbas

g.text: 01 / ANALYZUME
AI-powered resume analyzer that scores, parses, and provides actionable feedback on job applications.
Uses NLP and intelligent matching to help candidates optimize their resumes for target roles.
REACT · NODE.JS · AI/NLP · RESUME ANALYSIS · FULL-STACK
02 / LAYERS LANDING PAGE
Modern, responsive landing page built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS featuring smooth animations.
Showcases component-driven design, performance optimization, and polished UI/UX patterns.
NEXT.JS · TAILWIND CSS · TYPESCRIPT · FRAMER MOTION · RESPONSIVE DESIGN
03 / RENTO
Full-stack car rental application with booking management, user authentication, and admin dashboards.
Built on the MERN stack with real-time availability tracking and seamless payment flows.
REACT · NODE.JS · EXPRESS · MONGODB · MERN · AUTH
04 / ZYRAH E-COMMERCE
Feature-rich e-commerce web application with product catalog, cart, checkout, and order management.
Scalable architecture with responsive design serving thousands of users across devices.
REACT · NODE.JS · MONGODB · REDUX · E-COMMERCE · PAYMENTS
05 / META KEYS — 3D KEYBOARD
Immersive 3D keyboard website built with Three.js featuring interactive key animations and WebGL rendering.
Blends creative 3D modeling with frontend engineering for a standout portfolio experience.
THREE.JS · WEBGL · REACT · 3D MODELING · BLENDER · INTERACTIVE UI
06 / SIGNALIST
Stock market analyzer with real-time data visualization, trend analysis, and portfolio insights.
Combines fintech domain knowledge with modern frontend patterns for actionable market intelligence.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · FINANCIAL DATA · CHARTS · FINTECH · ANALYTICS
